_description: Patient Assessment scenario — form payload for tests/patient-assessment.spec.ts. Filled into the Patient Assessment form (load/visit-form/{visitId}/patient-assessment, opened from the visit edit page's 'Patient Assessment' tab) of the target visit (visitId from config/config.json → patientAssessment.visitId). Static values are chosen from the real option lists on staging; 'DYNAMIC' fields get fresh values per run. The visit ID itself is NOT here — it lives in config/config.json so all tests share one value. Read-only fields (vitals, pain score, height, weight, designation) are auto-filled from the Flow Sheet and are intentionally absent.

_config._comment: No extra test parameters — the scenario is the form payload only.
